import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx') as z:
    print('ZIP ENTRIES:', z.namelist())
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('sheetId'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS)]
    print('SHEETS:', sheets)
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rid_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
    print('RELS:', rid_map)
    for name, sid, rid in sheets:
        target = rid_map.get(rid)
        print(f'--- sheet {name!r} target={target}')
        if target:
            path = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
            try:
                data = z.read(path)
            except KeyError:
                print('  (could not read', path, ')')
                continue
            root = ET.fromstring(data)
            sd = root.find('m:sheetData', NS)
            for row in list(sd)[:8]:
                cells = []
                for c in row:
                    ref = c.get('r')
                    t = c.get('t')
                    v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                    isv = c.find('m:is', NS)
                    val = v.text if v is not None else None
                    if t == 's' and val is not None:
                        val = 'shared:' + val
                    elif t == 'inlineStr' and isv is not None:
                        val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isv.iter())
                    cells.append((ref, t, val))
                print('  ', cells)

with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx') as z:
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS)]
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rid_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = rid_map.get(rid).lstrip('/')
        print(f'--- sheet {name!r} target={target}')
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        sd = root.find('m:sheetData', NS)
        for row in list(sd)[:8]:
            cells = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                s = c.get('s')
                v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                isv = c.find('m:is', NS)
                val = v.text if v is not None else None
                if t == 'inlineStr' and isv is not None:
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isv.iter())
                cells.append((ref, t, s, val))
